note: Hardcoded CJK characters per renderer source file. The app defaults to English, so this is an untranslated-copy backlog. The ratchet in scripts/verify-i18n.mjs only lets these numbers fall: run `node scripts/verify-i18n.mjs --update` after translating to tighten it. `characterClass` records which definition of "CJK" produced these counts; if it does not match scripts/cjk-characters.mjs, the counts are not comparable and the guard asks for `--rebaseline` instead.
